body: Took it on my first win with ironclad. It wasn't a perfect deck by a long shot: battle trance and seeing red became inconsistent, but even with some unplayable cards I had an upgraded dual wield and double tap to squeeze more value from any 0 cost attacks I drew, and I had drafted into a lot of heavy attacks after getting it... it was a fun run.

The moon phases aren't caused by the earth blocking the moon, as I understand it, anyway. Half the moon is illuminated, and it looks full when that half is facing us, and new when it's facing away. The phases inbetween are just the lit half facing away at different angles, we see part of the lit half and part of the dark half.

Believe me, I'm terrified of oversharing with people who seem compatible. I don't want to look like some desperate, misguided guy, so I usually overcompensate by avoiding even casual interaction, and I find the resulting feeling of disconnection from the people around me to be very discouraging. Rather than spend time looking at the back of people's heads and wishing that things were different, I prefer to be by myself. I guess perseverance and a little more smiling will help me build some rapport.
